lines.text: Nadab and Abihu offered unauthorized fire before the LORD, and fire from the LORD consumed them.
Aaron remained silent, and Mishael and Elzaphan carried the bodies outside the camp, still in their tunics.
Moses told Aaron and his sons not to tear their garments, and the whole house of Israel could mourn.
The LORD told Aaron and his sons not to drink wine when entering the Tent of Meeting, so they could teach the statutes.
Moses was angry that the sin offering goat was burned up, but Aaron explained and Moses was satisfied.
